input.command: rg -n "nameOfDay|weekday\"" apps packages --glob '!node_modules' | rg -v "weekday.test|^packages/lib/weekday.ts"; rg -n "^export|^const .*=.*=>|^function" packages/lib/availability.ts

content.text:
Changing `nameOfDay` could break 16 files: the definition, 5 direct callers, and 10 files two levels out. I didn't change anything.

**Definition**
- `packages/lib/weekday.ts`

**Direct callers (level 1)**
- `packages/lib/weekday.test.ts`: tests it directly.
- `packages/lib/availability.ts`: calls it with `"short"` inside `availabilityAsString`.
- `apps/web/modules/settings/my-account/general-view.tsx`: 7 calls that build the week-start options.
- `apps/web/modules/users/components/UserForm.tsx`: 7 calls that build the week-start options.
- `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/AvailableTimesHeader.tsx`: 1 call.

**Callers of those files (level 2)**
- Of `availabilityAsString`:
  - `packages/features/schedules/components/ScheduleListItem.tsx`
  - `packages/platform/atoms/availability/AvailabilitySettings.tsx`
  - `apps/web/test/lib/availabilityAsString.test.ts`
- Of the `UserForm` component:
  - `apps/web/modules/users/views/users-add-view.tsx`
  - `apps/web/modules/users/views/users-edit-view.tsx`
- Of the `GeneralView` default export from `general-view.tsx`:
  - `apps/web/app/(use-page-wrapper)/settings/(settings-layout)/my-account/general/page.tsx`
- Of the `AvailableTimesHeader` component:
  - `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/AvailableTimeSlots.tsx`
  - `apps/web/modules/embed/components/Embed.tsx`

Notes:
- **Signature-only change:** the level-2 files would only break if the change also altered what the level-1 functions or components expose. Their return values would change if the output of `nameOfDay` changed.
- **Excluded:** `apps/web/components/settings/TravelScheduleModal.tsx` only imports the `FormValues` type from `general-view.tsx`, so it doesn't call anything that reaches `nameOfDay`. `weekdayNames` in the same module is a separate function.
